description: An exhilarating 7-day adventure trip to Bali, focusing on outdoor activities, cultural experiences, and relaxation in Denpasar. This itinerary is designed for two travellers seeking an active and immersive experience.

accommodation.amenities: wifi, beach access, pool, airport shuttle, rooftop terrace

days.title: Arrival and Relaxation
days.description: Arrive in Denpasar, check into your hotel, and enjoy a relaxing afternoon by the pool or beach to unwind after your flight.

days.title: Zipline and Ropes Adventure
days.description: Kick off your adventure with an exciting zipline and ropes course, followed by a cultural evening.

activities.notes: What you'll see: Thrilling ziplines and challenging ropes courses amidst natural scenery.What to bring: Comfortable athletic clothing, closed-toe shoes, and water.What to eat: Local snacks and refreshments are often available near adventure parks.Good to know: Safety briefings and equipment are provided, ensuring a secure experience.

activities.activity_name: Denpasar Live Music & Dinner Evening — Premium Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: Enjoy live music performances and a delicious dinner in a vibrant setting.What to bring: Smart casual attire and your appetite.What to eat: A variety of local and international dishes will be served as part of the dinner experience.Good to know: This premium edition offers an enhanced dining and entertainment experience.

days.title: Snorkelling and Sunset Cruise
days.description: Explore the underwater world with a snorkelling trip and cap off the day with a scenic sunset cruise.

activities.activity_name: Snorkelling Day Trip from Denpasar — Afternoon Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: Vibrant coral reefs and diverse marine life in the clear waters of Bali.What to bring: Swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, and a waterproof camera.What to eat: Light snacks and drinks are typically provided on board.Good to know: All necessary snorkelling gear will be supplied, and guides will assist you.

What you'll see: Breathtaking sunset views over the ocean with the coastline in the distance.What to bring: A light jacket, camera, and comfortable attire.What to eat: Refreshments and light snacks are usually offered during the cruise.Good to know: This is a perfect way to relax and enjoy the beautiful Balinese evenings.

days.title: Mountain Hike and Local Culture
days.description: Embark on a mountain hike for stunning views, then immerse yourself in local culture with a photography tour.

activities.notes: What you'll see: Panoramic views of Bali's landscapes, including mountains and lush greenery.What to bring: Sturdy hiking shoes, water, sunscreen, and a hat.What to eat: Pack some energy bars or snacks for the hike.Good to know: The hike can be challenging, so a good level of fitness is recommended.

activities.activity_name: Denpasar Old Town Photography Tour — Premium Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: Historic buildings, bustling markets, and local life in Denpasar's old town.What to bring: Your camera, comfortable walking shoes, and a desire to capture unique moments.What to eat: Sample local street food during your exploration.Good to know: A guide will provide insights into the history and culture of the area, helping you find the best photo opportunities.

days.title: Bike Tour and Cooking Class
days.description: Enjoy a scenic bike tour through Denpasar, followed by a hands-on cooking class to learn Balinese cuisine.

activities.notes: What you'll see: Picturesque rice paddies, traditional villages, and local daily life.What to bring: Comfortable clothing, closed-toe shoes, sunscreen, and a water bottle.What to eat: Enjoy fresh fruit and local snacks during the tour.Good to know: Helmets and bikes are provided, and the tour is suitable for various fitness levels.

activities.activity_name: Denpasar Cooking Class with Local Chef — Private Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: Learn to prepare authentic Balinese dishes from a local chef.What to bring: Your enthusiasm for cooking and an empty stomach.What to eat: The delicious dishes you prepare during the class.Good to know: This private edition offers a personalized and intimate culinary experience.

days.title: Museum Visit and Free Time
days.description: Spend the morning exploring local museums and galleries, then enjoy some free time for shopping or further exploration.

activities.notes: What you'll see: A collection of Balinese art, historical artifacts, and cultural exhibits.What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes and a camera (where permitted).What to eat: Cafes are often available within or near museum complexes.Good to know: The pass allows access to multiple cultural institutions, offering a comprehensive overview.

days.title: Departure Preparation and Last Souvenirs
days.description: Enjoy a final Balinese breakfast, do some last-minute souvenir shopping, and prepare for your departure.
